provenance.paper: Ben Abacha, Yim, Fan and Lin (EACL 2023), An Empirical Study of Clinical Note Generation from Doctor-Patient Encounters
provenance.changes: Eight unchanged English training dialogues with line endings normalized. Korean translations and content-based SOAP review expectations were added for this demo; these are not official Korean or SOAP annotations. No validation/test dialogues are used as prompt examples.
provenance.purpose: Manual model regression cases, never injected into runtime prompts. These checks are not a certification or full benchmark.

cases.dialogue_en:
Doctor: What is going on with him?
Guest_family: He is complaining of chest pain.
cases.dialogue_ko:
의사: 무슨 일이 있나요?
보호자: 가슴이 아프다고 합니다.
review_cautions: Do not infer a diagnosis, examination or treatment from chest pain.

cases.dialogue_en:
Doctor: Any drug allergies? 
Patient: No.
cases.dialogue_ko:
의사: 약물 알레르기가 있나요?
환자: 없습니다.
review_cautions: Do not turn an explicit denial into unknown status.

cases.dialogue_en:
Doctor: Breath in breath out, let me tap it and see. Well, your lungs sound clear. 
Patient: Okay.
cases.dialogue_ko:
의사: 숨을 들이쉬고 내쉬세요. 두드려서 확인해 볼게요. 폐에서 깨끗한 소리가 들립니다.
환자: 알겠습니다.
review_cautions: Do not add normal vital signs or a normal respiratory rate.

cases.dialogue_en:
Guest_family: So, you mean it is something simple?
Doctor: Yes, it is probably sinus infection and then cough secondary to that infection.
Guest_family: Will that be treatable?
Doctor:  Yes, it is. 
Guest_family: Okay nice.
cases.dialogue_ko:
보호자: 그러면 단순한 문제라는 말씀이신가요?
의사: 네, 아마 부비동 감염이고 기침은 그 감염 때문에 생긴 것 같습니다.
보호자: 치료할 수 있나요?
의사: 네, 치료할 수 있습니다.
보호자: 다행이네요.

A: Clinician suspects sinus infection with secondary cough; uncertainty is retained.

review_cautions: Do not present probable infection as confirmed.
No specific treatment, medication or follow-up was given.

cases.dialogue_en:
Doctor: How are you moving around? Are you able to perform your day to day activities?
Patient: Little bit, not so much.
Doctor: So just listen to your body and go around as much as you can.
Patient: Okay.
Doctor: Do not overstress yourself.
Patient: Okay I can do that.
cases.dialogue_ko:
의사: 움직이는 것은 어떤가요? 일상생활은 할 수 있나요?
환자: 조금은 할 수 있지만 많이는 못 합니다.
의사: 몸 상태에 맞게 가능한 만큼 움직이세요.
환자: 알겠습니다.
의사: 무리하지 마세요.
환자: 그렇게 할게요.

S: Patient has limited ability to perform daily activities.

review_cautions: Retain functional limitation and the clinician advice in their separate sections.

cases.dialogue_en: Doctor: You can take Ibuprofen as needed for pain.
cases.dialogue_ko: 의사: 통증이 있을 때 필요에 따라 이부프로펜을 복용하셔도 됩니다.

P: Clinician advised ibuprofen as needed for pain.

review_cautions: Source label MEDICATIONS must not imply the patient already takes this medication.
Do not invent a dose or a maximum frequency.

cases.dialogue_en:
Doctor: How's he doing today? 
Guest_family: I think he might have fifth disease with sinusitis. It's been running rampant at his school. 
Doctor: Oh, wow. Let's see what we can do.
cases.dialogue_ko:
의사: 오늘 상태는 어떤가요?
보호자: 전염성 홍반과 부비동염인 것 같아요. 학교에서 많이 유행하고 있거든요.
의사: 그렇군요. 어떻게 할 수 있을지 보겠습니다.

S: Family suspects fifth disease with sinusitis, reportedly circulating at school.

review_cautions: Despite source ASSESSMENT label, the diagnosis is a family hypothesis, not a clinician diagnosis.
Do not add tests, treatment or referral.

cases.dialogue_en:
Doctor: Well, I am looking at your ultrasound report and honestly the only significant finding of this area is that it shows to be related to bone. 
Patient: Oh okay.
cases.dialogue_ko:
의사: 초음파 보고서를 보고 있습니다. 이 부위에서 유의한 소견은 뼈와 관련되어 보인다는 것뿐입니다.
환자: 그렇군요.

O: Available ultrasound finding is related to bone.

review_cautions: This is an available imaging result, even though the original dataset section label is LABS.
Do not invent a specific bone diagnosis.
